sections.heading: When packaged platforms do not fit
sections.body:
Linkworks is our composable enterprise application platform for complex business apps where packaged ERP or CRM does not fit. It is for organisations whose business application needs call for a different approach to packaged software.

Linkworks is part of our [Digital Transformation](/services/digital-transformation) and [Intelligent Enterprise Platforms](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms) portfolio.

Available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement.
